Name: This Mod Is Organic
Author: RealSweetPanda
Description:
[size=5][b][u][center] Info [/center][/u][/b][/size][center]
The mod adds "Organic Sticker Labels" which when you sell them, will double the price of all items sold that day!
By default this excludes Ancient Fruit, Starfruit, and Truffles, giving you the option to make a farm of your favorite crops in the endgame!

Default values designed to work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16209]Price Buffs[/url]﻿﻿ to really make crops other than Ancient Fruit and company more viable.

You can get the stickers by going into Qi's walnut room on Ginger Island and buying from the shop for 5 Qi Gems.
[size=5]
[/size]
[size=5][b][u] Notes 
[/u][/b][/size]
The mod is highly configurable, with support for modifying the Qi Gem purchase price, types of items affected, and the amount of sell price increase within GMCM.[/center][center]
Functions in Multiplayer.
[size=5]
[/size][/center][center][size=5][b][u] Compatibility 
[/u][/b][/size]Should work with all mods.[size=5][b][u]
[/u][/b][/size][/center][center][size=5]
